### Fall Bucket List: 11 Ways to Celebrate the Season at Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas Resorts


11/02/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 534 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/Fall-Bucket-List-11-Ways-to-Celebrate-the-Season-at-Caesars-Entertainments-Las-Vegas-Resorts-2026-NvetQ_FBeK-2026.pdf)


****[Download high-res images](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1khgXvvHVfTi7lM9Thqp_9i8MnVB_sNL4?usp=sharing) ****


**LAS VEGAS (Nov. 2, 2026)** - Fall feasts and festive deals are taking over Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas resorts this season. From pumpkin-inspired spa treatments to autumn cocktails, guests can check off their fall bucket list with these 11 ways to celebrate the season.


**1) Enjoy a pumpkin spa treatment**


There’s never enough pumpkin during the fall.[The Spa at Flamingo Las Vegas](https://www.caesars.com/flamingo-las-vegas/things-to-do/spa-and-fitness) offers a 50-minute Pumpkin Soufflé Facial, designed to leave guests’ skin hydrated and glowing with exfoliating pumpkin enzymes, a marshmallow mask and vanilla aromatherapy.


The Spa at Flamingo also offers a 50-minute Vanilla Pumpkin Comfort Massage, which includes warm stones and pumpkin lotion.


**Available:** Through Saturday, Jan. 30, 2027


**Hours of Operation:** Open daily from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.


**Price:** Both treatments start at $140 **** **Reservations:**[caesars.com/flamingo-las-vegas/things-to-do/spa-and-fitness](http://caesars.com/flamingo-las-vegas/things-to-do/spa-and-fitness)


**2) Order a Turkey Wellington**


[Gordon Ramsay Steak](https://www.caesars.com/paris-las-vegas/restaurants/gordon-ramsay-steak) at Paris Las Vegas will offer a three-course Thanksgiving Tasting Menu, featuring a holiday-inspired Turkey Wellington entree. In true Gordon Ramsay fashion, the meal ends with Sticky Toffee Pudding for dessert.


The Thanksgiving Tasting Menu is available only on Thanksgiving Day.


**Available:** Thursday, Nov. 26, from 4 to 10:30 p.m.


**Price:** $159.99 per person **** **Reservations:**[caesars.com/paris-las-vegas/restaurants/gordon-ramsay-steak](http://caesars.com/paris-las-vegas/restaurants/gordon-ramsay-steak)


**3) Leave the Thanksgiving cooking at home**


Guests looking for more options on Thanksgiving Day can enjoy the Smoked Turkey Leg at[Guy Fieri's Vegas Kitchen & Bar at The LINQ Hotel + Casino](https://www.caesars.com/linq/restaurants/guy-fieris-vegas-kitchen-and-bar) or prix fixe menus at[Ruth's Chris Steak House](https://www.caesars.com/harrahs-las-vegas/restaurants/ruths-chris-steak-house) and[Ramsay’s Kitchen at Harrah's Las Vegas](https://www.caesars.com/harrahs-las-vegas/restaurants/ramsays-kitchen-by-gordon-ramsay) ,[Bugsy & Meyer's Steakhouse at Flamingo Las Vegas](https://www.caesars.com/flamingo-las-vegas/restaurants/bugsy-and-meyers-steakhouse) and[GIADA at The Vanderpump Hotel](https://www.caesars.com/vanderpump-hotel/restaurants/giada) .


**Available:** Thursday, Nov. 26


- Guy Fieri’s Vegas Kitchen & Bar at The LINQ Hotel + Casino, Bugsy & Meyer’s Steakhouse at Flamingo Las Vegas, Ramsay’s Kitchen and Ruth’s Chris Steak House at Harrah’s Las Vegas: 4 to 10 p.m.


- GIADA at The Vanderpump Hotel: 4:30 to 10 p.m.


**Price:**


- Guy Fieri’s Vegas Kitchen & Bar at The LINQ Hotel + Casino: $59.99 per person


- Ruth’s Chris Steak House at Harrah’s Las Vegas: $89.95 per person


- Bugsy & Meyer’s Steakhouse at Flamingo Las Vegas: $89.95 per person


- Ramsay’s Kitchen at Harrah’s Las Vegas: $89.95 per person


- GIADA at The Vanderpump Hotel: $129 per person


**Reservations:**


- [caesars.com/linq/restaurants/guy-fieris-vegas-kitchen-and-bar](http://caesars.com/linq/restaurants/guy-fieris-vegas-kitchen-and-bar)


- [caesars.com/harrahs-las-vegas/restaurants/ruths-chris-steak-house](http://caesars.com/harrahs-las-vegas/restaurants/ruths-chris-steak-house)


- [caesars.com/flamingo-las-vegas/restaurants/bugsy-and-meyers-steakhouse](http://caesars.com/flamingo-las-vegas/restaurants/bugsy-and-meyers-steakhouse)


- [caesars.com/harrahs-las-vegas/restaurants/ramsays-kitchen-by-gordon-ramsay](https://www.caesars.com/harrahs-las-vegas/restaurants/ramsays-kitchen-by-gordon-ramsay)


- [caesars.com/vanderpump-hotel/restaurants/giada](https://www.caesars.com/vanderpump-hotel/restaurants/giada)


**4) Take a Thanksgiving meal to-go**


The Thanksgiving Prix Fixe at[The Bedford by Martha Stewart at Paris Las Vegas](https://www.caesars.com/paris-las-vegas/restaurants/the-bedford-by-martha-stewart) will be available Tuesday, Nov. 24, through Sunday, Nov. 29. The menu includes Butternut Squash Soup and Big Martha's Pierogis, followed by a choice of Roasted Turkey or Prime Rib and finished with Pumpkin Pie for dessert.


Guests can now pre-order the Thanksgiving meal to-go for pickup on Thanksgiving Day.


**Available:** The dine-in Thanksgiving Prix Fixe menu will be available Tuesday, Nov. 24, through Sunday, Nov. 29, from 4 to 10 p.m. Pre-orders for the Thanksgiving to-go menu are now available through Tuesday, Nov. 24. Pickup for Thanksgiving to-go will be available on Thursday, Nov. 26 only.


**Price:**


- Thanksgiving Prix Fixe (dine-in): $124.99 per person


- Thanksgiving (to-go): Starts at $129.99


[Reservations](http://caesars.com/paris-las-vegas/restaurants/the-bedford-by-martha-stewart)


[Pre-order Thanksgiving To-Go](https://plv.playbytr.com/guest#/menu/3652?requesting=3777&tmpl=pages-ordering)


**5) Sip an Apple Cider Margarita**


Apple cider is another fall staple, and guests can get a taste of it at[Vanderpump Cocktail Garden at Caesars Palace](https://www.caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vanderpump) . The Apple Cider Margarita is crafted with tequila reposado, sweet cinnamon-vanilla agave and local apple cider.


**Available:** Through Monday, Nov. 30


**Hours of Operation:**


- Monday through Wednesday from 3 p.m. to midnight


- Thursday from noon to midnight


- Friday from noon to 1 a.m.


- Saturday from 10 a.m. to 1 a.m.


- Sunday from 10 a.m. to midnight


**Price:** $26.99 **** **** **Reservations:**[caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vanderpump](http://caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vanderpump)


**6) Eat a five-course meal (in ice cream form)**


The Salt & Straw scoop shops at[Flamingo Las Vegas](http://caesars.com/flamingo-las-vegas/restaurants/salt-and-straw) and[Paris Las Vegas](http://caesars.com/paris-las-vegas/restaurants/salt-and-straw) have turned a Thanksgiving dinner into ice cream. Guests have the month of November to try these sweet and savory flavors:


- Parker House Rolls with Salted Buttercream


- Maple Koginut Squash with Pomegranate


- Turkey and Bacon Caramel


- Pumpkin Pie with Almond Croissant Streusel


- Cranberry Shortbread Tart (Vegan)


**Available:** Through Friday, Nov. 27


**Hours of Operation:**


- Salt & Straw at Flamingo Las Vegas


- Salt & Straw at Paris Las Vegas


**For more information:**[caesars.com/flamingo-las-vegas/restaurants/salt-and-straw](http://caesars.com/flamingo-las-vegas/restaurants/salt-and-straw) or[caesars.com/paris-las-vegas/restaurants/salt-and-straw](http://caesars.com/paris-las-vegas/restaurants/salt-and-straw)


**7) Feast like a Caesar**


There’s no better place to indulge in a holiday feast than[Bacchanal Buffet at Caesars Palace](https://www.caesars.com/caesars-palace/restaurants/bacchanal-buffet) . Guests can enjoy seasonal items, including Citrus Brined Turkey, Candied Yams with Brûléed Marshmallows, Boursin Mashed Potatoes and Giblet Gravy.


**Available:**


- Wednesday, Nov. 25, from 2:30 to 9 p.m.


- Nov. 26-29, from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.


**Price:**


- Wednesday, Nov. 25: $52.49 per child, $94.99 per adult


- Nov. 26-27: $54.99 per child, $99.99 per adult


- Saturday, Nov. 28


- Sunday, Nov. 29: $86.99 per child, $91.99 per adult


**Reservations:**[caesars.com/caesars-palace/restaurants/bacchanal-buffet](http://caesars.com/caesars-palace/restaurants/bacchanal-buffet)


**8) Book a Vegas vacation**


On Monday, Nov. 16, guests can get early access to Caesars Entertainment’s Cyber Sale, with up to 60% off all eight Las Vegas hotels for stays through October 2027.


Regular access to the Cyber Sale will be available on Monday, Nov. 30. The sale will also extend from Tuesday, Dec. 1, through Friday, Dec. 4


Guests can also score $50 tickets to select shows across Caesars Entertainment's Las Vegas resorts, including performances by Thomas Rhett, Alex Warren, Koe Wetzel, Bailey Zimmerman, Nikki Glaser, David Spade, Jeff Dunham, Donny Osmond and Wayne Newton. In addition, guests can purchase two tickets for $50 to the[High Roller Observation Wheel](https://www.caesars.com/linq/things-to-do/attractions/high-roller) ,[Fly LINQ Zipline](https://www.caesars.com/linq/things-to-do/attractions/fly-linq) and[Eiffel Tower Viewing Deck](https://www.caesars.com/paris-las-vegas/things-to-do/attractions/eiffel-tower) . Offers are available through Friday, Dec. 4.


**Available:**


- Early access: Monday, Nov. 16


- Cyber Sale: Monday, Nov. 30


- Cyber Sale extension: Dec. 1-4


**For more information or to make a reservation:**[caesars.com/sale](http://caesars.com/sale)


**9) Pre-order a pie**


No Thanksgiving is complete without pie. The following pies are now available in-store by the slice at[Dominique Ansel Las Vegas at Caesars Palace](https://www.caesars.com/caesars-palace/restaurants/dominique-ansel) and[Dominique Ansel Marché at Paris Las Vegas](https://www.caesars.com/paris-las-vegas/restaurants/dominique-ansel-marche) :


- Bourbon Pecan Pie


- Extra Silky Pumpkin Pie


- Salted Caramel Apple Pie


Guests can pre-order full pies now for pick-up at the Caesars Palace or Paris Las Vegas location during Thanksgiving week.


**Available:**


- Pre-orders for whole pies are now available through Thursday, Nov. 26 for in-store pick-up from Tuesday, Nov. 24 to Thursday, Nov. 26.


- Pie slices are now available in-store through Thursday, Nov. 26.


- Whole pies will be available in-store from Saturday, Nov. 14 through Thursday, Nov. 26.


**** **Hours of Operation:**


- Dominique Ansel Las Vegas at Caesars Palace


- Dominique Ansel Marché at Paris Las Vegas


**Price:** $70.99 per pie, $12.99 per slice **** ****[For more information on Dominique Ansel Las Vegas at Caesars Palace](https://www.caesars.com/caesars-palace/restaurants/dominique-ansel)


[For more information on Dominique Ansel Marché at Paris Las Vegas](https://www.caesars.com/paris-las-vegas/restaurants/dominique-ansel-marche)


[Pre-order a pie from Dominique Ansel Las Vegas at Caesars Palace](http://dominiqueansellasvegas.com/)


[Pre-order a pie from Dominique Ansel Marché at Paris Las Vegas](https://dominiqueanselmarche.com/)


**10) Cozy up with fall flavors**


[Caramella Italian Restaurant & Lounge at Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino](https://www.caesars.com/planet-hollywood/restaurants/caramella-italian-restaurant-and-lounge) is serving up the flavors of the season with a limited-time fall menu. Guests can enjoy Butternut Agnolotti, Seafood Cioppino, Osso Buco or Frantoiana.


**Available:** Through Thursday, Dec. 31


- Monday through Friday from 4 to 10 p.m.


- Saturday and Sunday from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. and 4 to 10 p.m.


**Price:** $22-69


**Reservations:**[caesars.com/planet-hollywood/restaurants/caramella](http://caesars.com/planet-hollywood/restaurants/caramella)


**11) Try a cocktail from one of the world’s best bars**


Those looking for a unique cocktail experience can check out the SIPS Drinkery House pop-up at[VISTA Cocktail Lounge at Caesars Palace](https://www.caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vista-cocktail-lounge) . Guests can try signature drinks from Barcelona’s SIPS, named The World’s Best Bar by The World’s Best 50 Bars in 2023, and make a toast to the season.


****


**Available:** Through Thursday, Dec. 31


**Hours of Operation:**


- Monday through Thursday from 2 p.m. to 2 a.m.


- Friday through Sunday from 10 a.m. to 2 a.m.


**Price:** $25.99 per cocktail


**Reservations:**[caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vista-cocktail-lounge](https://www.caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vista-cocktail-lounge) ****


## **Bonus: Save like a local**


## Las Vegas locals can make the most of their fall bucket list with Caesars Entertainment's Las Vegas locals offer, available through Dec. 26. Nevada residents receive complimentary self-parking at all eight Caesars Entertainment Las Vegas resorts by scanning a valid Nevada ID at parking garage exits. Residents who are Caesars Rewards® members also receive 25% off eligible drink and dining experiences, while all Nevada residents can access discounted rates on hotel stays, select spa treatments and attractions. For more details, guests can visit[caesars.com/las-vegas/hotels/deals/locals](https://www.caesars.com/las-vegas/hotels/deals/locals) .


**Veterans Day Deals**


Veterans and active-duty military members can save on their next Las Vegas getaway with Caesars Rewards' Veterans Day Military Discount. Verified military members can receive up to 25% off Caesars Entertainment's lowest available hotel rates when booking through ID.me. The offer is available for reservations made Nov. 4-11 and is valid for travel through November 2027. For more information, guests can visit[caesars.com/book/?trooptype=all](http://caesars.com/book/?trooptype=all) . Blackout dates apply.


In addition to discounted hotel rates, military members and first responders can take advantage of "Guy's Salute to Service" at Guy Fieri's Vegas Kitchen & Bar at The LINQ Hotel + Casino. The offer features the All American Bacon Burger with fries for $25, with a portion of proceeds benefiting the Guy Fieri Foundation, which supports heroes and first responders. Active-duty military members and veterans also receive a complimentary domestic draft beer, while military members and first responders receive 25% off their meals.
